Top 3 Salary Tiers (DENSE_RANK)

MediumFreeQuerying BasicsWindow FunctionsSubqueries & CTEs

Comp planning wants every employee in the top 3 distinct salary tiers — multiple people can share a tier, and tier 4+ is filtered out.

Use DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) to assign a tier per employee, then keep only tier <= 3. Show name, department, salary, tier. Order by tier, then name.

Why DENSE_RANK here: if three people earn $95K and you ask for "the top 3 *tiers*", you want all three of them plus everyone at the next two distinct salaries. RANK would skip from 1 → 4 after a 3-way tie and you'd lose the next tier. ROW_NUMBER would break ties arbitrarily and only show 3 rows. DENSE_RANK is exactly the right tool for tier semantics.
